name: Takyon Networks Ltd
title: Takyon Networks Ltd - 544471 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: H2 FY26 revenue fell to Rs 28.97 cr with EBITDA margin 5.3% as management deliberately deferred loss-making fixed-price contracts amid component inflation; FY27 guided to 15-20% growth on a 32 cr order book, margin 11-13%.

triggers.label: Component prices up 40% to 300%
triggers.quote: experienced price inflation of 40% to over 300% even in some components

triggers.label: H2 revenue Rs 28.97 cr; FY26 Rs 71 cr
triggers.quote: the company reported revenue of Rs. 28.97 crores

triggers.label: FY27 revenue to beat FY25 by ~15%
triggers.quote: We will surpass our FY 24 FY25 numbers by close to 15%.

triggers.label: Deferred loss-making fixed-price contracts
triggers.quote: defer the execution of fixed-price contracts

guidance.value: Meaningfully higher than FY26; ~15% above FY25 level
guidance.quote: We will surpass our FY 24 FY25 numbers by close to 15%.

guidance.value: 20-22 cr billed in H1 FY27 out of 32 cr
guidance.quote: close to 20 to 22 crores, we would be able to bill it in FY

red_flags.label: Revenue down ~31% FY26; H2 sharply lower
red_flags.quote: FY26 full-year revenue was around 71 crores. It is 31% lower than FY25.

red_flags.label: Management shifts to 'not a base' with unquantified guidance
red_flags.quote: It is not a base. That's very clear, it is not a baseline.

red_flags.label: Inconsistent figures: 100 cr baseline vs FY26 71 cr; 'close to 10%' vs 5.3% H2 margin
red_flags.quote: we have a baseline of that 100 crore

red_flags.label: Customer-contract cancellation of Rs 5 cr order
red_flags.quote: one 5 crore order, we didn't lose it, but we, with the good relation with the customer, we managed to, get it, get the, get it canceled.

red_flags.label: Receivables/payables: trade payables cut from 30.21 to 3.77 cr
red_flags.quote: We reduced our trade payables from 30.21 crores to 3.77 crores.

evasions.quote: We cannot provide any point-specific revenue, and I want to explain why that is
We have not told any 3-4 month number.

evasions.topic: Fixed-price share of order book and escalation protection
evasions.quote: So, any further increase yes, that will definitely hit the margin
